title: Satellite Contracts OPA Policy Input Schema

hasEvolyamlAtProjectRoot.description: Whether the satellite project has exactly one evolith.yaml at its project root (ADR-0109: project-scoped, previously repo-scoped hasEvolyamlAtRoot).

isWorkspace.description: Whether the satellite is a workspace (monorepo) declared by an evolith.workspace.yaml. Absent/false for single-project satellites (ADR-0109).

workspaceIntegrityOk.description: Whether the workspace passes SVC-06 integrity: every discovered evolith.yaml corresponds to a declared spec.projects[].path and vice versa. Only evaluated when isWorkspace is true (ADR-0109).

nameIsUnique.description: Read by satellite-contracts.rego. Declared by GT-695.

needsGovernanceUpgrade.description: Read by satellite-contracts.rego. Declared by GT-695.

upgradePathDocumented.description: Read by satellite-contracts.rego. Declared by GT-695.
